{"category_edits":[{"category":"feature_construction","rationale":"Across all four datasets, square-root the normalized training-only log-frequency feature to increase attenuation of moderately frequent historical items. Keep the 1-0.3*feature scaling, embeddings, causal convolutions, readout, loss and optimizer unchanged. The existing checkpoint buffer and predictor loader preserve training/inference consistency.","edits":[{"find":"    frequency_feature = np.log1p(training_counts)
    frequency_feature /= max(float(frequency_feature.max()), 1.0)
","replace":"    frequency_feature = np.log1p(training_counts)
    frequency_feature /= max(float(frequency_feature.max()), 1.0)
    frequency_feature = np.sqrt(frequency_feature)
"}]}],"change_summary":"Apply square-root normalized log-frequency input features to all four category models, retaining zero features for unseen items and existing checkpoint/predictor compatibility."}
